snippet.title: Penguin Colony - Official Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026
snippet.description:
Cosmic horror, through the eyes of a penguin. Watch the latest Penguin Colony trailer for this upcoming retro Lovecraftian walking simulator. In Penguin Colony, rival human factions have come to your home in the Antarctic, seeking an ancient and inconceivable being. Observe their descent into insanity in this faithful reimagining of H.P. Lovecraft’s At the Mountains of Madness, and other stories. 

Penguin Colony will be available on PC on October 16, 2026. A demo is out now on Steam.
